rationale: Dzianis brings hands-on web3 and blockchain engineering expertise from Coinbase with a strong JavaScript/frontend stack, while Xiaoan is building AR/mixed reality systems that need robust web integration (WebXR, React, TypeScript). Xiaoan's vision of direct manipulation interfaces on smart glasses could benefit from Dzianis's experience shipping secure, user-facing crypto applications — and Dzianis may find compelling use cases for web3 in spatially-aware, AI-augmented devices.
intro_message: Dzianis, meet Xiaoan (Sean) Liu — he's building spatial computing and AR systems at Fusion Reality, and your Coinbase backend and web3 experience could intersect with how his smart glasses interfaces handle secure, context-aware interactions.
